description: This file defines the implementation of the NetworkIsolationKey class, including constructors, methods for serialization, debugging, and state checks, within the net namespace. It manages network isolation keys based on site and origin information, with support for cross-site flags and nonces.

classes.name: NetworkIsolationKey
classes.description: Represents a key used for network isolation, based on site and origin information, supporting cross-site flags and nonces, with methods for serialization, debugging, and state validation.

methods.name: NetworkIsolationKey
methods.description: Constructors for initializing NetworkIsolationKey objects with various site, origin, and nonce parameters.

methods.name: CreateTransient
methods.description: Creates a transient (non-persistent) NetworkIsolationKey with opaque sites.

methods.name: CreateWithNewFrameSite
methods.description: Creates a new NetworkIsolationKey with the same top frame site but a different frame site.

methods.name: ToCacheKeyString
methods.description: Serializes the key into a string suitable for caching, depending on the mode.

methods.name: ToDebugString
methods.description: Returns a human-readable string representing the key's state for debugging.

methods.name: IsFullyPopulated
methods.description: Checks if the key has all necessary site information populated.

methods.name: IsTransient
methods.description: Determines if the key is transient (not fully populated or opaque).

methods.name: GetMode
methods.description: Static method to determine the current mode based on feature flags.

methods.name: GetFrameSite
methods.description: Returns the frame site if mode is enabled.

methods.name: GetIsCrossSite
methods.description: Returns whether the key is cross-site if mode is enabled.

methods.name: IsEmpty
methods.description: Checks if both top and frame sites are empty.

methods.name: IsOpaque
methods.description: Checks if the key is opaque based on site opacity and nonce.
